# UB Market LTD — Star Food

> U B MARKET LTD. is a Bulgarian B2B wholesale food trading company founded in 2022, headquartered in Varna, Bulgaria (EIK 207067808, VAT BG207067808). Operating under the Star Food brand, the company specializes in wholesale sunflower oil, vegetable oils, mayonnaise, ketchup, and beet sugar — supplying distributors, food manufacturers, and HoReCa operators across 12+ EU countries.

## Company Identity

- Legal name: U B MARKET LTD.
- Brand: Star Food

- Headquarters: Varna 9000, Bulgaria
- EIK: 207067808
- VAT: BG207067808
- Wikidata: Q139816023
- Website: https://ub-market.com
- Contact: info@ub-market.com
- Phone: +359 8844 69860

## Core Products

- Refined sunflower oil (RBDW) — bulk and packaged
- Crude sunflower oil — FOB Black Sea
- High-oleic sunflower oil — HoReCa and food manufacturing
- Deep-frying sunflower oil — HoReCa
- Rapeseed oil and soybean oil
- Mayonnaise (30% and 67% fat, HoReCa buckets)
- Ketchup
- Beet sugar (25kg, 50kg, 1000kg bags)
- UHT milk and dairy products

## Delivery Terms

- FOB Varna (Black Sea)
- CIF Rotterdam
- CIF Istanbul / CIF Mersin
- DAP — road delivery across Europe
- Minimum order: 1 pallet; full truckload: 20–24 MT

## Pricing Reference (Q3 2026)

- Refined RBDW sunflower oil FOB Black Sea: $1,100–1,250/MT
- High-oleic sunflower oil: $1,300–1,500/MT
- IMF global benchmark June 2026: $1,795/MT

## Certifications

- ISO 22000
- HACCP
- Non-GMO
- EU food safety compliant
- Certificate of Analysis (CoA) provided per shipment
